HelmAnswer.dc.html.title: Helm: ask Odysseus, answer above the bar

Main.dc.html.title: New tab: the trail as a constellation

m1.text: Helm answers. The bar grows into the question, and the answer sits right above it with its sources drawn as linked stars. It names where the answer came from.

m2.text: Closed tabs dim into faint stars below the open trail. Hover for a preview, then relight to bring the page back. They fade out after a day.

m3.text: Private. Stars become hollow rings, the trail line turns dashed and the accent shifts to lilac, so the mode is visible without a banner.

m4.text: History keeps the trail shape. Pages opened from another branch off it, and a page you returned to shows as a brighter star.

n1.text: The Trail. Tabs are stars joined by a line, and tabs opened from another one branch off it. Narrow shows stars only, wide shows titles.

n2.text: The Helm. One command bar at the bottom, where your thumbs rest and the page keeps its full height. Downloads show as a ring around its icon.

n3.text: One sky. On a new tab the sky runs edge to edge and your trail is drawn as a constellation. On a real page it retreats to the rail.

n4.text: Corner notch for Shields and window controls. The page is square against the window and rounded only where it meets the trail.
